/scripts.value:
on FixResponseArray
	local tTemp, tDecodedResponse
	
	put quizliChatCreateQuizLastMessage into tDecodedResponse
	
	put JSONImport(tDecodedResponse) into quizliAIIncomingQuestionsArray 
	
	 if "properties" is among the lines of the keys of quizliAIIncomingQuestionsArray then
		// GPT returned incorrect array nested in a 'properties' key"
		put quizliAIIncomingQuestionsArray["properties"] into tTemp
		put tTemp["Questions"] into quizliAIIncomingQuestionsArray
	else if "items" is among the lines of the keys of quizliAIIncomingQuestionsArray["questions"] then
		delete variable quizliAIIncomingQuestionsArray["questions"]
	else if the keys of quizliAIIncomingQuestionsArray contains "questions" then
		put quizliAIIncomingQuestionsArray["questions"] into tTemp
		put quizliAIIncomingQuestionsArray["quiz length"] into lastKnownEstimatedQuizLength 
		put tTemp into quizliAIIncomingQuestionsArray 
	else
		answer "an unknown error happened, the response is not correct. breakpoint will trigger"
	end if
	
	if the keys of quizliAIIncomingQuestionsArray["questions"] is empty then
		delete variable quizliAIIncomingQuestionsArray["questions"] 
	end if 
	
end FixResponseArray

function cleanJSONString pJSONString
	return pJSONString
end cleanJSONString
